header.running_head: Honouring the Household Members of Rasulullaah ﷺ's Family

blocks.text: ﷺ that he left the Masjid with Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) after performing the Asr salaah. Hadhrat Ali (RA) was walking on the right of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) when they passed by Hadhrat Ali (RA)'s son Hadhrat Hasan (RA) playing with some other boys. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) put the boy on his shoulders as he said a couplet which meant:

"May my father be sacrificed! This boy is the image of Nabi ﷺ
and in no way resembled his father"
Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) Kisses Hadhrat Hasan (RA)'s Stomach

Hadhrat Umayr bin Is'haaq reports that he saw Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) meet Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA) and say, "Show me that part of your stomach where I saw Rasulullaah ﷺ kiss." When Hadhrat Hasan (RA) did so, Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) also kissed the spot. Another narration states that Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) kissed his navel.[^2] Yet another narration states that when Hadhrat Hasan (RA) uncovered his belly, Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) placed his hand on Hadhrat Hasan (RA)'s navel.[^3]
Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) Uses the Words "My Guide" when Addressing Hadhrat Hasan (RA)

Hadhrat Maqbari reports that they were once with Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) when Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA) arrived and greeted them with Salaam. The people returned the greeting but Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) was unaware of what happened until somebody said to him, "That was Hasan bin Ali who greeted with Salaam." Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) then went to meet Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and said, "Salaams to you too, O my leader." When someone asked Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) why he had addressed Hadhrat Hasan (RA) as "my leader", Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) replied, "I testify that I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'He is a leader.'"[^4]
The Incident Between Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) and Marwaan Concerning Having Love for Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA)

Marwaan once visited Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) during the illness that claimed his life. Marwaan said, "Since we have been living with you, nothing has angered us more than your love for Hasan and Husayn." Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah
Ibn Sa'd, Ahmad, Bukhaari, Nasa'ee and Haakim, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.103).
Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.177) has commented on the chain of narrators. Ibn Najjaar has reported a similar narration, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.104).

Tabraani, reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.187). Abu Ya'la and Ibn Asaakir have reported a similar narration, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.104), as has Haakim (Vol.3 Pg.169).
